items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section VIII, List of Answers on Terminology 33:1
items.html: It means that the legs of the Partzufim of Atzilut will end evenly with the legs of the Partzufim of AK. For before the end of correction, the legs of the Partzufim of Atzilut are found to end at the Parsa that is above the world of Beria, where the discernment of the point of the Sium of the second restriction is. But at the end of correction the second restriction will be cancelled, and the three worlds BYA will return to the degree of Atzilut. Then the legs of the Partzufim of Atzilut will lengthen down to the point of this world, like the Sium of the legs of AK, in the secret of the verse, “and His feet shall stand upon the Mount of Olives.” Thus the legs of Atzilut and the legs of AK are in a single Sium. And this is what is written in the Zohar: “When leg reaches leg, the King Messiah will come.” (p. 679, Item 89)
